### Nordson Corporation Announces Earnings Release and Webcast for Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2026


April 30, 2026


WESTLAKE, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nordson Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nordson.com&esheet=54525462&newsitemid=20260429141625&lan=en-US&anchor=Nordson+Corporation&index=1&md5=5d7ebfbcc166aa6708789c0b6151a5cd) **** (Nasdaq: NDSN) today announced it will release second quarter fiscal year 2026 earnings on May 20, 2026, after the close of the market. Nordson will host its quarterly webcast on:


Date:


Thursday, May 21, 2026


Time:


8:30 AM ET


Link to listen:


[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/689480295](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F689480295&esheet=54525462&newsitemid=20260429141625&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F689480295&index=2&md5=df15e9e76e419bd2ebdba43be988a3dd)


Investors who are interested in listening to the webcast, but are not able to participate during the scheduled time, can access the replay by visiting[Nordson's investor website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nordson.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54525462&newsitemid=20260429141625&lan=en-US&anchor=Nordson%27s+investor+website&index=3&md5=a23882fb2fc9e418a330e6031252a7e6) .


Nordson Corporation is an innovative precision technology company that leverages a scalable growth framework through an entrepreneurial, division-led organization to deliver top tier growth with leading margins and returns. The Company’s direct sales model and applications expertise serves global customers through a wide variety of critical applications. Its diverse end market exposure includes consumer non-durable, medical, electronics and industrial end markets. Founded in 1954 and headquartered in Westlake, Ohio, the Company has operations and support offices in over 35 countries. Visit Nordson on the web at[www.nordson.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nordson.com&esheet=54525462&newsitemid=20260429141625&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nordson.com&index=4&md5=905d58bb681ab5d9796ca8f4be9c66fe) ,[linkedin/Nordson](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnordson-corporation%2F&esheet=54525462&newsitemid=20260429141625&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin%2FNordson&index=5&md5=2ae9485c96f844d308ef61fd845c4cd9) , or[www.facebook.com/nordson](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fnordson&esheet=54525462&newsitemid=20260429141625&lan=en-US&anchor=www.facebook.com%2Fnordson&index=6&md5=1b75a117a9f3000f3a46bb57d18dbde6) .
